observed.caption: An elevated hazy view of a densely congested urban street lined with unfinished concrete buildings and commercial buildings covered in large phone billboards.
observed.description: A wide elevated view looks down along a long straight street packed with dense clusters of small vehicles including white vans, buses and cars, and many tiny pedestrian figures along the sidewalks and between vehicles. On the left and center-right stand large unfinished gray concrete buildings covered in scaffolding, netting and rooftop construction debris. On the right are light-colored commercial buildings with glass windows, one with a red rooftop sign and another white building covered with repeated logos and large rectangular billboards displaying phone images. In the immediate foreground is a tan building with a flat brown rooftop. In the background a dense hazy cityscape of indistinct buildings fades into atmospheric haze under diffuse daylight.
